statement: For every algebraically closed field, every general Weierstrass model with nonzero discriminant, every stage n and every tuple of n+3 inputs, the actual canonical recursive resultant polynomial evaluates to zero iff actual Mathlib curve points with precisely those affine xcoordinates sum to zero. The same combined Lean theorem directly refutes the rational-only universal converse on the actual nonsingular F5curve y²=x³+1.
